populationDefinition: All 5,124 slots represented by the authenticated X profile count at review time, with a public-safe disposition for each slot.
method: Authenticated read-only reconciliation of the public Posts and Replies surfaces plus a bounded authored-status search and an independent Posts-tab crosscheck. Full post text and browser-session material are intentionally excluded.
completenessStatement: Complete accounting, not complete item recovery: this ledger dispositions 100 percent of the 5,124-slot live-profile control. It recovers 3,367 surviving public items at item level and preserves 1,757 slots as unresolved historical profile-count debt; it is not a platform export, deletion history, or claim of 100 percent item-level recovery.
metricBoundary: Mutable interface reaction metrics are excluded. Metrics on reposts would belong to the source status and are not converted into @NYCArtC traction.
contentBoundary: Raw post text, outbound URLs and labels, mutable reaction metrics, authenticated-session data, private analytics, and protected research artifacts are excluded. Content and link digests support later reconciliation without publishing the text or linked-artifact corpus.
